official_sources.2018_2021_distribution_amounts: Samsung Asset Management official monthly KODEX product sheets
official_sources.2022_2026_events: Samsung Asset Management official KODEX distribution API

conservative_assumptions: For 2018-2021, the official product sheets disclose distribution amounts but not payment dates in the historical table.
Those payment dates are inferred as the second subsequent KRX trading session and the full gross amount is treated as taxable.
From 2022 onward, record dates, payment dates, gross amounts, and taxable amounts use the official API values.
